Where core renders product media, it uses a plain with no CSS colour treatment (research/products-diagnostics/MemberCatalogExperience.tsx:116-130, MemberProductDetailExperience.tsx:167-176). Production would show the asset's own pixels.
rows.currentOldPreviewBehavior: Every card image gets `filter: saturate(0.82) contrast(0.98)` (preview-src/preview.css:470-475) plus an inset 60/90px bottom vignette (preview.css:477-483). Detail media (preview.css:889-893) and QA-grid thumbs (preview.css:1167-1173) are unfiltered. The detail carries width/height=1254 attributes (preview.js:206; all 423 rows are 1254x1254). Those override the CSS `aspect-ratio: 1`, so the detail renders a 554x1254 tall centre slice of a square asset (preview/research-detail-desktop-1440.png, y about 236-1490). Crop agent-crops/completeness/pv-detail-vs-card-image-grading.png shows the same calibration-01-vial asset greyer and darker on cards (mean HSV saturation 45 vs 59, value 65 vs 76; regions differ, but this is consistent with saturate .82 plus the vignette).
rows.observedDifference: The founder is approving grade, crop and scale. On cards, the grade they see is a CSS effect production does not apply. The QA grid and detail page show the same file at a different grade, and the detail crop was never chosen. An approval would not transfer to production pixels.
rows.proposedXeniosHealthDelta: Treat the old-preview difference as candidate drift, not a new design decision. The proposed Xenios Health surface should converge on Core and apply this review direction: Remove the filter and the ::after vignette from .product-visual. Bake any approved grade into the asset files. Render card, detail and QA thumb from identical pixels. Fix the attribute/aspect-ratio conflict (set height:auto plus a CSS aspect-ratio, as core's CatalogDiscoveryImage does) so the crop shown is the crop chosen. If a CSS treatment is wanted in production, propose it to the core lane as a change to the core media component.
rows.actionRequired: Remove the filter and the ::after vignette from .product-visual. Bake any approved grade into the asset files. Render card, detail and QA thumb from identical pixels.
